scope: Initial, non-exhaustive Baltic ecosystem collection. Listing is not endorsement. Dates without times are not calendar-ready.

organisations.name: Solana Baltics
organisations.summary: Solana Baltics connects builders and hosts meetups across Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.

organisations.name: Blockchain Lithuania
organisations.summary: Blockchain Lithuania brings together people working with blockchain and Web3, with a public meetup archive.
organisations.note: September 2026 Solana event listed. Former Blockchain Centre Vilnius links should not create duplicate records.

organisations.name: Crypto Economy Organisation
organisations.summary: Crypto Economy Organisation represents the crypto ecosystem and supports education, meetups and the Web3 Summit.

organisations.name: Crypto Hub Lithuania
organisations.summary: Crypto Hub Lithuania promotes crypto, blockchain and DeFi through discussions, research and education.
organisations.note: Organisation profile confirmed; no upcoming meetup independently confirmed.

organisations.name: Latvian Blockchain Association
organisations.summary: The Latvian Blockchain Association brings together blockchain businesses and supports the local ecosystem.
organisations.note: Different organisation from Baltic Blockchain Association Riga.

organisations.name: Baltic Blockchain Association Riga
organisations.summary: Baltic Blockchain Association Riga hosts discussions on distributed ledgers and practical applications.
organisations.note: One past event visible; recurring activity is not established.

organisations.name: Estonian Web3 Chamber
organisations.summary: Estonian Web3 Chamber connects organisations and individuals through education, industry cooperation and community activities.

organisations.name: Blockchain Tallinn
organisations.summary: Blockchain Tallinn is a meetup community previously called Blockchain & Ethereum Tallinn.
organisations.note: Do not list the former name as a separate group.

organisations.name: ETHTallinn
organisations.summary: ETHTallinn organised an Ethereum and Web3 hackathon in Tallinn. Its community channels remain a useful starting point.
organisations.note: Official page still advertises 19–21 April 2024. No new edition confirmed.

organisations.name: CryptoMondays Vilnius
organisations.summary: CryptoMondays Vilnius hosted local discussions and Ethereum conference recaps.
organisations.note: Evidence is from 2023. Current local activity needs confirmation.

organisations.name: Vilnius Blockchain Club
organisations.summary: Vilnius Blockchain Club has an archive of blockchain technology talks and webinars.
organisations.note: Most recent event visible in the inspected listing is June 2021.

organisations.name: W3B LAB IDA
organisations.summary: W3B LAB IDA is a Web3 community initiative whose launch was reported by the Estonian Web3 Chamber.
organisations.note: Launch evidence only. Direct community channels and current activity need confirmation.

organisations.name: MoneroPay
organisations.summary: MoneroPay is an open-source Monero payment backend with a contributor based in Vilnius. It is a software project, not a local meetup community.
organisations.note: Regional connection through contributor Laurynas Četyrkinas (@stnby), whose public GitLab profile lists Vilnius and links to MoneroPay. This does not establish a Lithuanian headquarters or a local Monero community.

organisations.name: Kernal
organisations.summary: Kernal publishes technical work on security, privacy and free software, including MoneroPay.
organisations.note: Lithuanian connection through contributors; not a dedicated Monero meetup organisation.

organisations.name: CoinGate
organisations.summary: CoinGate develops cryptocurrency payment tools for businesses, with roots in Vilnius.

organisations.name: SUPER HOW?
organisations.summary: SUPER HOW? develops blockchain systems and researches digital infrastructure from Lithuania.

organisations.name: Swapin
organisations.summary: Swapin provides crypto-to-bank payment services and lists an office in Tallinn.

organisations.name: CryptoSwift
organisations.summary: CryptoSwift develops Travel Rule compliance software and is based in Tartu.

organisations.name: Gravity Team
organisations.summary: Gravity Team provides crypto market-making and liquidity services, with a team in Riga.

organisations.name: Blockvis
organisations.summary: Blockvis builds AI and blockchain-related software and is a member of the Latvian Blockchain Association.
organisations.note: Current website emphasises AI; retain an accurate description rather than presenting it as a crypto-only company.

organisations.name: UN:BLOCK
organisations.summary: UN:BLOCK hosts a conference in Riga covering blockchain, digital assets and financial technology.
organisations.note: Homepage announces 10–11 March 2027; About retains the 1–2 April 2026 edition. These are separate editions.

organisations.name: W3N
organisations.summary: W3N is a Narva gathering covering Web3 and other emerging technologies.
organisations.note: Date conflict on organiser site: title says December 2026, body says January 2027 and January 2026. Confirm with organiser before putting a date in the calendar.

organisations.name: Web3 Summit Vilnius
organisations.summary: Web3 Summit brought blockchain discussions to Vilnius, with Crypto Economy Organisation among the organisers.
organisations.note: A 9 November 2023 edition is documented by LITEXPO. No forthcoming Vilnius edition confirmed.

organisations.name: PROOF
organisations.summary: PROOF brings together discussions on privacy, decentralised tools and sovereignty in Vilnius.

organisations.name: Baltic Honeybadger
organisations.summary: Baltic Honeybadger is a Bitcoin-focused conference in Riga.
organisations.note: Keep the Bitcoin-only scope explicit; link to Bitcoin Baltics for deeper coverage.

organisations.name: Zolak / Centralny Crypto Bar
organisations.summary: Zolak is a Vilnius community venue with a crypto payment page.
organisations.note: Different indexed versions use Zolak and Centralny. Confirm current venue name and accepted assets before map integration.

organisations.name: Bitcoin Baltics
organisations.summary: Bitcoin Baltics brings together Bitcoin places, meetups and conferences across the three Baltic countries.

organisations.name: Lithuania BTC
organisations.summary: Lithuania BTC connects local Bitcoin meetups, walks and merchants in Lithuania.

events.name: Solana Connect
events.summary: A community evening around Solana, stablecoins, payments and onchain finance.

events.name: UN:BLOCK Fintech Forum
events.summary: Fintech forum with crypto licensing and digital payment sessions.
events.locationNote: See organiser for final venue and timetable.

events.name: UN:BLOCK 2027
events.summary: Blockchain, digital assets, fintech and AI conference.
events.locationNote: See organiser for venue and timetable.

events.name: Solana Baltics Vibecheck
events.summary: A gathering of the Baltic Solana community during Startup Fair.

events.name: UN:BLOCK 2026
events.summary: The 2026 Riga edition covering blockchain and financial technology.

events.name: ETHTallinn 2024
events.summary: A three-day Ethereum and Web3 hackathon.

events.name: Web3 Summit Vilnius 2023
events.summary: A documented Lithuanian Web3 conference edition.

openQuestions: No active dedicated Monero meetup confirmed in the three countries.
W3N dates conflict; no dated event created.
CryptoMondays Vilnius and ETHTallinn need a current activity check.
Krüpto Klubi is mentioned by CryptoSwift, but a current official community URL is not confirmed.
BTC Map supports Bitcoin acceptance only, not other assets.
